title: Smoke Test — Door Amount-Received + Required Comp Reason
subtitle: Agent enters the cash actually collected at the door (partial allowed); comp/write-off now requires an audit reason. Same order O-6FDWJZ5, staged to $100.

meta.Flow: Door records the entered amount (partial → balance stays outstanding, attendee still admitted) → admin comps the remainder with a required reason
meta.Order: O-6FDWJZ5 (id 15), staged to AWAITING_OFFLINE_PAYMENT / $100, attendee Sam Spade (A-ZV8IDXP)
meta.Design rule: Door = record reconcilable money (any amount, captured with method + reference + IP). Comp = forgive a balance, authenticated only, now reason-required.
meta.Data: Order 15 staged then restored via ops/smoke/checkin-payment/RESTORE.sql

steps.title: Door — amount received field (defaults to order total)
steps.description: The 'Check in and record payment' form now shows the order total and an 'Amount received' field defaulting to it, with guidance: less leaves a balance due, more is recorded as overpaid. The agent enters what actually hit the drawer / Square.

steps.title: Door — short cash entered ($40 of $100)
steps.description: The agent could only collect $40 (e.g. couldn't make change, or a part payment). The amount is set to $40 and the reference captures who collected it. The action button reflects the entered amount: 'Check in and record $40.00 payment'.
steps.notes: Recording an arbitrary amount can no longer corrupt the order — it's a ledger credit, not a rewrite of total_gross.

steps.title: Partial recorded — balance stays outstanding, attendee admitted
steps.description: Manage-Order shows Owed $100 / Collected $40 / Outstanding $60. The CASH $40 row carries the agent's point-in-time memo ('Cash — collected by J. Doe') and the recorded IP — your reconciliation trail against the drawer/bank. The order stays awaiting payment and the attendee was still checked in.

steps.title: Comp now requires a reason
steps.description: Comping the $60 remainder opens a modal that blocks submission without a reason: 'A reason is required to comp a balance' (enforced server-side too). A comp forgives a receivable with no money to reconcile, so the reason is the audit trail.

steps.title: Comp reason entered
steps.description: The operator records why the balance is being forgiven (e.g. 'Board-approved sponsor comp — remainder waived per 5/30 vote').

steps.title: Settled — cash + comp, both with their memos
steps.description: Final ledger: Collected $40 (cash) + Comped $60 = settled. Both rows show their context — the cash receipt's reference and the comp's audit reason — giving a complete, reconcilable money-movement record. Attendee is now ACTIVE.
